title: astrology globe: the params of scene.play

img.description: Which body: moon, mercury, venus, mars or jupiter.

lit.description: The fraction of its disc that is lit.

side.description: 1 when its right side is lit, -1 when its left. The Moon: 1 waxing, -1 waning. A planet: 1 when it is east of the Sun ((its longitude - the Sun's) mod 360 is under 180), else -1.

r.description: 0.62 for the Moon, 0.58 for a planet.

spin.description: Degrees per second it turns, for show: 0 for the Moon, 2 mercury, 3 venus, 7 mars, 29 jupiter.
